Quick notes on how we typically run the 30–45d evaluation:
- Week 0: Kickoff + environment access (API keys/whitelisted IPs)
- Weeks 1–2: Core feature validation (latency, throughput, quality checks on your test set)
- Weeks 3–4: Ops & security review, SLA band discussion, quantization/throughput tuning
- Final week: Acceptance criteria review, procurement/contract alignment

Marissa (cc'd) will own the technical validation plan and can propose times for an initial tech deep-dive next week. Ben will help coordinate pricing/contract questions and procurement intake.

Related files attached: MAP-template-v1.docx and a two-slide timeline stub we use for exec briefings (Vantage-eval-timeline-slides.pptx). I can also export to a one-pager PDF if that helps present to your VP.

Next steps:
1) Marissa to propose 2 slots for technical validation meeting (30–45m).
2) Alex to add any internal stakeholders to the GDoc and flag non-negotiable dates.
3) Ben to start preliminary procurement checklist (T&Cs + SOC 2 questions).

I put a short MAP starter in the GDoc under "Proposed milestones" — feel free to edit directly.

Hi Alex — looping in a suggested technical validation plan (I drafted the details in the GDoc under 'Tech validation'). Highlights below:

Proposed technical validation (2x week cadence)
- Tech deep-dive (30 min) — environment, API keys, expected load patterns (Day 1)
- Ingest sample corpus (your redacted test set) — measure latency p50/p95, token counts (Week 1)
- Throughput experiment (batching/quantization) — capture cost delta (Week 2)
- Edge cases & hallucination checks — create acceptance prompt set (Week 2–3)
- Ops review (data retention/audit logs) — confirm logging endpoints and retention windows (Week 3)

Success criteria (draft)
- p95 latency below 1.8s for baseline 512-token runs on sample set
- Mean token cost within target budget (TBD with procurement)
- No unresolved security items (SOC2 artifact review complete)

Suggested immediate slots for initial deep-dive (PST):
- Tue 23 Sep — 10:00–10:45
- Wed 24 Sep — 14:00–14:45

If neither works, propose two windows that fit your VP's calendar and we will prioritize. I'll update the GDoc timeline to reflect the 30–45d cadence and add a contact matrix for who owns each milestone.

Thanks —
